wargear.name: Iron Halo
wargear.text: A model with an Iron Halo has a 4+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Melta Bomb
wargear.text: In combat, a model with this wargear may forgo its attacks and instead make a single Strength 8, AP1 attack with the Melta Special rule at Initiative step 1.

wargear.name: Rosarius
wargear.text: A model with a Rosarius has a 4+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Auspex Scanner
wargear.text: Enemy units may not Infiltrate within 18" of a model equipped with this wargear.

wargear.name: Refractor field
wargear.text: A model with a refractor Field has a 5+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Psychic Hood
wargear.text: A unit equipped with this wargear gains the Deny the Witch special rule.

wargear.name: Storm Shields
wargear.text: Storm Shields provide the model equipped with the Storm Shield a 4+ Invulnerable save. A model with a Storm Shield gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

wargear.name: Chapter Banner
wargear.text: Friendly Space Marines units within 12" of the Banner can re-roll Pinning and Panic tests. In addition, when calculating the number of wounds caused in a combat for the purpose of determining if a unit within 12" of a model with this wargear has won or lost a combat, add 1 to the number of wounds caused by friendly Space Marine units within 12" of a model with this wargear.

wargear.name: Bionics
wargear.text: A model with this wargear gains the Feel no Pain (6+) special rule.

wargear.name: Digital Weapons
wargear.text: A model with Digital weapons gains +1 to their Attacks (A) characteristic.

wargear.name: Null Rod
wargear.text: A model with this Wargear cannot be affected by Psychic Powers. In addition, a model with this special rule gains the Bane (Psykers) on all Melee weapons it is equipped with.

wargear.name: Narthecium/Medkit
wargear.text: A model with this Wargear and their attached unit gain Feel No Pain (5+) Special rule.

wargear.name: Grav Chute
wargear.text: A model with a Grav Chute gains the Deep Strike Special rule.

wargear.name: Vox Caster
wargear.text: A unit with this Wargear automatically Rallies at the start of its Movement phase.

wargear.name: Combat Shields
wargear.text: A model equipped with this wargear has a 6+ Invulnerable save. In addition, they gain +1 to their Armour Save Max 2+) in the Combat Phase.

wargear.name: Teleport Homer
wargear.text: A unit that arrives on the battlefield via Deep Strike within 12" of a unit with this wargear does not scatter

wargear.name: Boarding Shields
wargear.text: A model equipped with this wargear gains a 5+ Invulnerable save. If at least 3 models in a unit are equipped with Boarding Shields, all charges against the equipped unit are treated as Disordered Charges.

wargear.name: Psyocculum
wargear.text: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Ignores Cover and Precision Strikes special rule on all weapons they are equipped with.

wargear.name: Psyber Eagle
wargear.text: Enemy models may not arrive from Deep Strike or Outflank within 12" of this unit. In addition, at the start of each Shooting Phase, you may select 1 enemy unit visible to Coteaz. Coteaz and any attached unit gain +1 to all hit rolls when targeting the selected unit until the end of the phase.

wargear.name: Throne of Judgement
wargear.text: A model equipped with this wargear gains has a 3+ Armour Save and a 4+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Wyvach Familiar
wargear.text: This wargear grants the unit the Night Vision special rule and +6" to the range of Shooting Weapons they are equipped with that do not have the Grenade type.

wargear.name: Garralisk
wargear.text: A model with this wargear counts as a Cavalry type unit and gains all associated benefits. The equipped unit gains +1 to their Toughness (T), Wounds (W) and Attacks (A) characteristics.

wargear.name: Reinforced Void Armour
wargear.text: A model equipped with this wargear has a 4+ Armour save. A model with this wargear can re-roll all Armour Save rolls made against wounds caused by weapons with the Spray, Blast or Large Blast special rule.

wargear.name: Power Armour
wargear.text: Basic Power Armour. It provides a 3+ Armour Save.

wargear.name: Artificer Armour
wargear.text: Master work Armour issued to veterans and champions. It provides a 2+ Armour Save.

wargear.name: Flak Armour
wargear.text: Basic Combat armour. It provides a 5+ Armour Save.

wargear.name: Carapace Armour
wargear.text: Heavy Combat Armour. It confers a 4+ Armour save.

wargear.name: Penance Engine
wargear.text: This mechanical engine is a solid piece of war machine that is capable of withstanding incoming fire as it charges blindly towards foes. It confers a 4+ Armour save.

wargear.name: Armoured Plate
wargear.text: Heavy Armoured plating protects the armoured walking vehicles of the Guard. It confers a 3+ Armour save

wargear.name: Indomitus Terminator Armour
wargear.text: The Standard Terminator Armour used by most Astartes forces. It provides a 2+ Armour Save and a 5+ Invulnerable Save. The wearer gains the Relentless, Bulky (2) and Deep Strike special rule. Models equipped with this Armour may not perform Sweeping Advances.

wargear.name: Paragon War Suit
wargear.text: These ancient mechanical walker suits provide a high degree of protection to their pilot through various armour panels over the pilots standard Power armour and strong energy shields. It confers a 2+ Armour save and a 4+ Invulnerable save. The equipped model gains +1 Strength (S) and +2 to its Toughness (T) characteristic. The equipped model gains the Firing Protocols (2) and Relentless special rule.

wargear.name: Dreadnought Plate
wargear.text: These ancient and powerful mechanised war suit encompasses a sarcophagus where an ancient warrior lay entombed. When combined, the warrior may take to the field again with a new body. It confers a 2+ Armour save.

wargear.name: Assassin Suit
wargear.text: A skintight and flexible suit used by assassins that allows unparalleled movement. It confers a 6+ Armour save and a 5+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Gravis Armour
wargear.text: Gravis Armour is a bulk multi-layered heavy assault Armour for Primaris. It provides a 3+ Armour save and grants the wearer +1 to their Toughness (T) characteristic. The wearers Movement (M) Characteristic is decreased by 1". The model gains the Bulky (2) special rule. If a model wearing Gravis Armour is hit by a weapon with the Blast or Large Blast special rule, decrease the AP of the weapon by 1 (e.g 3 becomes 4) for the purposes of resolving that hit. The model gains the Relentless Special rule.

wargear.name: Phobos Armour
wargear.text: A Stealth designed version of the standard power Armour for infiltration. It provides a 3+ Armour save and grants the wearer the Infiltrate special rule.

wargear.name: Jump Pack
wargear.text: A model with this wargear increases their Movement (M) characteristic to 12". It gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly and Deep Strike special rules.

wargear.name: Mount
wargear.text: A unit that is equipped with a Mount becomes the Cavalry type. In addition, the model gains +1 to its Wounds (W) characteristic. A mount is equipped with close combat weapons.

wargear.name: Smoke Launchers
wargear.text: A model equipped with this Wargear can set to smoke instead of Overwatching. Until the start of its next turn, the model gains a 4+ Cover Save.

wargear.name: Searchlight
wargear.text: A model with this special rule gains the Night Vision special rule. Any unit that it targets in the Shooting Phase no longer gains the benefit of Night Fighting. Any attacks against this unit are not affected by Night Fighting.

wargear.name: Assault launchers
wargear.text: A model equipped with this Wargear can make 1 additional Hammer of Wrath Attack.

wargear.name: The Book of Emperor Ascendant
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. Friendly units within 12" of a model bearing this Relic gain +1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic. Once per game, the equipped model may open the book in their Shooting Phase. Select 1 enemy unit within 12" to take D3+2, Strength 14, AP1 Automatic hits.

wargear.name: The Sanctic Shard
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. Once per game, this model may attempt to cast the Hammerhand Psychic Power, a model equipped with this relic automatically succeeds. The model does not need to have purchased the Hammerhand Psychic Weapon.

wargear.name: Plate Armor
wargear.text: A model with this wargear has a 3+ Armor save but cannot perform Sweeping Advances.

wargear.name: Buckler Shield
wargear.text: A model with this wargear gains +1 to its Armor save in the Combat Phase.

wargear.name: Storm Shield
wargear.text: A model equipped with this wargear has a 4+ Invulnerable Save. A model equipped with this wargear gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

wargear.name: Synskin Bodyglove
wargear.text: This wargear confers a 4+ Armour save and 4+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Etherium
wargear.text: Models with a Leadership (LD) characteristic 7 or below may not target this unit for shooting attacks in the Shooting Phase.

wargear.name: Judgement Proclamatory
wargear.text: Enemy units within 3" of a model equipped with this wargear must re-roll successful Panic Tests.

wargear.name: Riot Shield
wargear.text: If a unit includes 2 or more models equipped with this wargear, all charges against this unit are resolved as 11.1.4 - Disordered Charges. This wargear confers a 5+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Lasgun Array
wargear.text: If this unit is transporting Embarked models, it may make an additional 6 Attacks in the Combat Phase at its normal initiative with its Cult Crew Weapons.

wargear.name: Ion Gauntlet Shield
wargear.text: A model with this wargear has a 5+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Heavy Plate
wargear.text: A unit with this wargear has a 5+ Armor save.

wargear.name: Jump Pack (Tempestus Scion Aquilon Squad)
wargear.text: A unit that is equipped with a Jump Pack increases its Movement (M) characteristic to 12". The model gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Bulky (2), Fly, and Deep Strike special rules.

wargear.name: Infernum Halo Launcher
wargear.text: Instead of setting to Overwatch, this unit may set to Deploy Chaff. When this unit deploys Chaff, all attacks against this unit have -1 to all hit rolls until the start of this units next Shooting Phase.

wargear.name: Auspex Array
wargear.text: Enemy units may not arrive via Deep Strike within 6" of this unit. This unit gains the Ignores Cover on all weapons it is equipped with.

wargear.name: Void Shields

parameter.description: the number of Void Shield Tokens

wargear.text: A unit with this wargear gains a number of Void Shield Tokens equal to the value of (x). Each time this unit takes a Penetrating Hit, if it has a Void Shield Token, you spend a token to ignore that Penetrating Hit. At the start of each Battle Round, you regain 1 spent Void Shield Token. Instead of setting to Overwatch, you can set to Recharge Voids. A unit that Recharges Voids, regains all of its Void Shield Tokens.

wargear.name: Dreadknight
wargear.text: A model equipped with this wargear has a 2+ Armour save and 4+ Invulnerable save. The model gains the Deep Strike special rule.
